response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior individual contributor with 15+ years of hands-on engineering, some fintech exposure (RIDE Capital), and recent AI-agent tooling work (MCP generators at re:cinq). However, the role is an executive CTO position requiring a track record of scaling engineering organizations from 10 to 30+, developing technical leadership layers, governing outsourced delivery, and operating production multi-agent AI systems in regulated environments — none of which is evidenced. His career trajectory is IC-focused with no people-leadership or board-level experience, making him a poor fit for this executive mandate despite solid technical breadth.
strengths: Broad full-stack and distributed-systems experience, including high-throughput low-latency microservices at Sociomantic
Recent hands-on exposure to agentic AI infrastructure (MCP code generators, agentic workflow frameworks)
Some fintech domain exposure via RIDE Capital and strong engineering-craft practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development)
concerns: No executive or engineering-management experience; entire career is individual-contributor roles
No demonstrated production multi-agent AI systems, LLM evaluation, or fine-tuning experience at the depth required
No evidence of team scaling (10→30+), outsourced-engineering governance, or board-level communication
